title: Windows Notes App
tagline: WPF notes with multi-user auth, real-time search, and SQL persistence
intro: University project: a responsive WPF notes application with login-based user isolation and SQL storage.
summary: C# + WPF desktop app supporting user accounts, CRUD notes, instant search, and background threading for smooth UX. Emphasizes validation and data integrity.

sections.title: Description
sections.body: A WPF notes application enabling secure, user-specific note management with responsive UI and local SQL storage.

sections.title: Objective / Aim
sections.body: Provide a secure, efficient notes tool with persistent storage and smooth UX.

sections.title: Role & Responsibilities
sections.body: Built auth, DB integration, CRUD flows, real-time search, and validation.

sections.title: Features / Implementation
sections.body: Threaded search; parameterized queries; input validation; modular MVVM-style components.

sections.title: Impact / Results
sections.body: Functional, secure notes app demonstrating OOP, WPF, and SQL integration.
